session.direct: Same-meal exact named phase median shrunk to phase family then compatible calendar state then current deployed final total; n/(n+3), no fixed holiday floor or multiplied weather factors
session.trend: Convex blend direct phase level and last three observed same-phase-family sessions, weight n/(n+3); absolute levels not multiplied
session.counts: Independent observed unique dish count medians using identical hierarchy, never tied proportionally to sales
session.count_adjustment: Original candidate eligibility, original selection and 80% repeat enforcement; full baseline fixed-menu paired sales comparison

item.relative: Own typical-sales scaled shallow partition with relative supply changes and known calendar boundary distances
item.drop: Own-history relative-q10 decline classifier plus low/normal conditional distributions; no absolute size features
item.typical: Own pre-day historical median point benchmark
item.fit: Every 7 calendar days, all prior supplied records, depth2, leaf>=80, thresholds at feature quartiles; fixed not searched
item.zero: Keep explicit zeros, absent supply not zero; unknown decline threshold not labelled
ablation: train historical hits only after common warmup

hierarchy: Same-meal/unit category response to historical versus current recommended competitor counts, independent category model then within-category own-demand weights; no true target menu
coordination: Existing bounded projection for paired main controls. New expected-risk marginal allocator only if raw MAPE improves>=0.25pp, raw WMAPE<=1.05 baseline, normal raw error<=max(1pp,5%) regression. Record skipped attempts otherwise.
combination: Demand+count; own-drop+hierarchy; selected demand+item; each parent/removed mechanism recorded, failed exploratory combinations not production candidates
gates: phase_protocol.json unchanged; no adjusted thresholds after results
test: No 2026 outcome loading before code/config freeze
